999008199.text:
おや、まだここにいたのですか。
何か私に話でも？

localizations.en: Oh, you're still here. Did you need to speak with me about something?

999008199.text:
ちょっと気になっただけよ。
それはそうと、最近は何をしているの？

localizations.en: I was just a bit curious. So what have you been up to lately?

999008199.text:
王国の研究に力を貸していますよ。
成果を出せばそれなりに待遇は良くしてもらえます

localizations.en: I've been lending my expertise to the kingdom's research efforts. If I produce results, they treat me reasonably well.

999008199.text:
あなたほどであれば、もっと協力すれば
待遇の改善は見込めると思いますが

localizations.en: Someone of your caliber could probably negotiate much better terms if you were more cooperative.

999008199.text: 誰かの言いなりになるのって、嫌なのよね

localizations.en: I just hate being at someone else's beck and call, you know?

999008199.text:
まあ、あなたならそう言うと思っていました。
お互いできることを頑張りましょう

localizations.en: Well, I expected you'd say that. Let's both do what we can in our own ways.
Indeed. I'll see you later then.
